name: socialbatch
headline: socialbatch: Claude Code skill for marketing
short_description: SocialBatch: Everything you need to start run manage and grow your social marketing and online advertising. Social Platforms: Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, Youtube, Instagram. Social planning, Scheduling,management, Analytics and reporting with built in tools to create and edit social content.  Integrate: FB,TW,Pin,G+,google drive/dropbox
author: capsulecreative

sections.overview:
SocialBatch is a social media management platform designed for businesses looking to streamline their online presence across multiple channels. It supports Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, YouTube, and Instagram, offering core features including social planning, scheduling, management, analytics, and reporting. The tool includes built-in content creation and editing capabilities, and integrates with Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, Google+, Google Drive, and Dropbox to centralize your workflow.
Schedule and publish posts across Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, YouTube, and Instagram from a single dashboard
Plan and manage multi-platform social media campaigns with integrated content creation tools
Track social media performance with built-in analytics and generate reports across all channels
Store and organize social content assets using Google Drive or Dropbox integrations
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/capsulecreative/socialbatch`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a social media manager for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use SocialBatch to create a 30-day social media content calendar for [PLATFORMS] focusing on [CAMPAIGN_GOAL]. Include 3 content ideas per platform, optimal posting times, and a brief strategy for engagement.
```
Copy

```
# Social Media Content Calendar for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
